# Duos Technologies Group to Ring the Nasdaq Stock Market Opening Bell Friday, November 27, 2026


November 24, 2026 8:30am EST[Download as PDF](https://ir.duostechnologies.com/_assets/_8585d87912c58dbb38c792b1c0c8c218/duostechnologies/news/2026-11-24_Duos_Technologies_Group_to_Ring_the_Nasdaq_Stock_863.pdf)


### Company Also Provides Additional Detail on 2026 Financial Outlook, Including Fourth Quarter Revenue Breakdown


JACKSONVILLE, Fla., Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Duos Technologies Group, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=hgi4rlUmPDdteNHsEyvPS-pLOQZJ7CJAKkY24wtwe90-QpaiLj4b87msmXKK07TgHf6lno4GlOoF-hjRzNrsBn8y-_8mdru37zAbq4rI0I05kotf2TAQXCDSzevVEbbT) (“Duos” or the “Company”) ([Nasdaq: DUOT](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=h0Fh0HSay2AAS-DEBkjAjBL08quL63_7VRzrEzgapce-vjWP0I4GKj0yL2P4FdviYCUxvruWN-xmYhZorYtkyrPyJuGO2QK_3vqVF_97isE=) ), a provider of adaptive, modular architecture compute center colocation and infrastructure solutions, today announced that it will visit the Nasdaq MarketSite in Times Square to ring the Opening Bell on Friday, November 27, 2026. The ceremony will be broadcast beginning at 9:15 a.m. ET on the[Nasdaq website](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=h0Fh0HSay2AAS-DEBkjAjNEQW8ne3tyAXuqPJGCwY8nWuCKwMaQJv6QqJRjeHijTEaCC7fB25NjTqNnxivjmjYuopOfAM0li8rues9ZlPofv3_Zq3yGZuAJY8FSIoRHX) .


Doug Recker, Chief Executive Officer of Duos, will ring the Opening Bell, joined by members of the Company's leadership team, employees, and invited guests.


The ceremony marks Duos' strategic transformation and its focus on building the next generation of American compute infrastructure. Duos develops, owns, and operates compute centers using a scalable, modular approach, emphasizing speed to power and bringing computing capacity closer to customers and communities.


“Ringing the Nasdaq Opening Bell is a proud moment for everyone who has helped build Duos,” said Duos CEO Doug Recker. “We believe the future of American computing infrastructure belongs closer to the communities it serves. By bringing scalable computing capacity to underserved markets, we're connecting communities to new opportunities and helping build America's digital future.”


**Where:** Nasdaq MarketSite | 4 Times Square (43rd & Broadway) | New York, NY
**When:** Friday, November 27th, 2026 | 9:15 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. ET
**Livestream:** A live webcast of the Opening Bell ceremony will be available[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=OS5LudLs8frj64oCjxNePXcSMgW2hKKaIjmqYEGRjlBSeK1GtqGk--mnzkSAXRIFnLPCGkn14pboygWrc5LMV9LKO9lslPs-R5aU8IodZzZsnK8znGlvvaTUFJUty8yn) .


**Updated 2026 Financial Outlook**
On November 16, the Company[reported financial results](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=iHbfBvCT6eevfNj66vP0M4cEWAafOcIfVq-r8lZh2yoS7_g-TtcPwTRIkKwAq6m3aiOqS23F4g_9osM9nC10usRnsr7yMuMiOLAb7Ha6IRlH7ez0zDoSJCOifIKjaYgGSvsjwtP-J1Po5gxybTjK75coZIvkozBTv8nwb2ZU6oSE5AgBdu0PlQuPyVawgvhYGYOl4YCFEqjXCa7-Oz2SzDb6czGR-XrsFF69E0YJTXc=) for the third quarter of 2026. As part of the report, Duos reaffirmed its expectations for 2026 revenue to exceed $50 million with positive full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA.


With additional progress achieved to date in the current quarter, the Company now has greater visibility into its fourth quarter performance and is providing the following additional detail.


Fourth quarter results are expected to reflect a full quarter of revenue from the 5 MW of hosting capacity that came online at the beginning of the fourth quarter at Duos’ Columbus, Georgia site. Hosting revenue differs from colocation revenue because hosting revenue includes the compute capacity of GPUs rented through the Company’s strategic partner. As a result, this 5 MW hosting arrangement is expected to generate in excess of $6.5 million per month. Because of the GPU rental component, the hosting arrangement also carries higher operating costs than a typical colocation site. This one-time hosting arrangement should not be used to estimate per-megawatt revenue and costs for pure colocation, which the Company outlined on its third quarter earnings call.


Going forward, the Company is focused on running colocation sites that generate higher site-level EBITDA contribution, consistent with its strategic repositioning as a colocation and infrastructure company. Duos does not anticipate recording pure colocation revenue until 2027. Hosting and colocation revenue are reported together in the Company’s financial statements as “Hosting and Colocation.”


In addition, in the fourth quarter Duos expects to record approximately $1 million from its remaining Services and Consulting agreement, and the Technology Solutions segment is expected to contribute at least $10 million in revenue.


In total, the Company expects fourth quarter revenue to exceed $31 million.
